bib.title: HybridRAG: Integrating Knowledge Graphs and Vector Retrieval Augmented Generation for Efficient Information Extraction

question: Does combining vector-based retrieval and knowledge-graph retrieval contexts improve RAG question answering over earnings call transcripts compared with either alone?
hypothesis: Concatenating VectorRAG and GraphRAG contexts yields more accurate answers than either alone, because each covers the other's failure cases.
contributions: HybridRAG: concatenating VectorRAG and GraphRAG contexts for generation
A ground-truth Q&A dataset built from Nifty-50 earnings call transcripts
Comparison of VectorRAG, GraphRAG and HybridRAG on retrieval and generation metrics

method.summary: Earnings call PDFs are chunked; one pipeline embeds chunks into Pinecone (VectorRAG), another builds a KG of LLM-extracted triplets queried by depth-1 DFS from the entity (GraphRAG). HybridRAG concatenates the vector context first and graph context second and feeds it to GPT-3.5-Turbo. All three are scored with modified RAGAS metrics.
method.task: question answering over financial earnings call transcripts (RAG)

datasets.name: Nifty-50 earnings call transcripts, Q1 FY2024 (quarter ending June 2023)
datasets.size: 50 documents; avg 27 pages, avg 60,000 tokens, avg 16 questions per document; 400 randomly selected questions with their exact responses as ground truth
datasets.split: no split; all used for evaluation
datasets.source: scraped from company websites with a custom web scraper; publicly available; not released (no link stated)
datasets.preprocessing: PyPDFLoader, RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter; KG chunks 2024 chars with 204 overlap (Sec 4.1)

other.use: answer generator, KG triplet extraction and RAGAS-style judge (judge model inferred: not stated explicitly)

inference.samples: inferred: one run per question; no seeds or repeats reported
inference.prompting: Q&A prompt template instructing LLM to act as expert Q&A system, use only provided context, not refer to the context; exact text not given
inference.retrieval: VectorRAG: Pinecone, chunk size 1024, overlap 0, 'Chunks for Similarity Algorithm' 20, 'Number of Context Retrieved' 4, filters on quarter, year, company. GraphRAG: LangChain NetworkxEntityGraph + GraphQAChain, DFS depth 1 from the entity; 13950 triplets, 11405 nodes, 13883 edges. HybridRAG: concatenate VectorRAG context then GraphRAG context.

other.kg_triplet_format: ['h','type','r','o','type','metadata']; entity descriptions under four words; two-tier LLM chain (abstract of chunk, then entity/relation extraction)

metrics.name: Faithfulness (F)
metrics.definition: |V|/|S|: supported statements over statements extracted from the answer by the LLM

metrics.name: Answer relevance (AR)
metrics.definition: mean cosine similarity (ada-002 embeddings) between original question and n questions the LLM generates from the answer

metrics.name: Context precision (CP)
metrics.definition: RAGAS: sum over ranks of precision@k times relevance indicator, divided by relevant items in top K

metrics.name: Context recall (CR)
metrics.definition: fraction of ground-truth sentences attributable to the retrieved context

eval.protocol: RAGAS framework 'modified a bit'; the modifications are not specified; single run; no significance test; LLM-as-judge model not named.

prompts.text: Given a question and answer, create one or more statements from each sentence in the given answer. question: [question] answer: [answer]
Generate a question for the given answer. answer: [answer]

Consider the given context and following statements, then determine whether they are supported by the information present in the context. Provide a brief explanation for each statement before arriving at the verdict (Yes/No). Provide a final verdict for each statement in order at the end in the given format. Do not deviate from the specified format. statement: [statement 1] ... statement: [statement n]

results.claim: Qualitative: GraphRAG better on extractive questions, VectorRAG on abstractive ones; GraphRAG can fail when no entity is named; hybrid falls back to whichever works.
results.setup: Same dataset; no per-question-type numbers given
results.table: Overall GraphRAG performs better in extractive questions compared to VectorRAG.

limits: Single proprietary-ish dataset of 400 questions from 50 Indian earnings calls; not released; no variance, seeds or significance tests.
Ground-truth answers are the management's actual responses in the transcript, and the questions come from the same documents.
Differences are small (0.94 vs 0.96 faithfulness) and judged by an unnamed LLM judge with 'modified' RAGAS.
HybridRAG lowers context precision (0.79); concatenation grows context and order affects precision.
Only baselines are the authors' own VectorRAG and GraphRAG; no other GraphRAG (e.g. Edge et al.) is run; no ablation of ordering, depth or k.
Authors list future work: multi-modal inputs, numerical analysis, better financial metrics, real-time data.
Exact KG extraction prompt omitted for space.
